items.title: What Are Accenture Stock Bears Missing?
items.summary: Accenture (ACN) is winning new artificial intelligence (AI) work, and that is what bears may be missing. You probably expect AI to shrink demand for consultants. The stock lost 24% over the past year, while the S&P 500 gained 18.0%. Over the past three months, though, Accenture stock has risen 38%. So is Accenture actually signing up new AI work.
